subject: Applicant
semantic_observation: Resolution distinguishes an identity in population/context but is not complete proofing
formalization_or_cq_signal: Potential proofing subevent; CQ should ask resolution vs validation vs verification

subject: Evidence
semantic_observation: Validation evaluates authenticity accuracy validity/currentness of evidence/attributes
formalization_or_cq_signal: Evidence validation relation/event may improve proofing traceability

subject: Applicant-Evidence
semantic_observation: Verification confirms validated evidence refers to presenting applicant

subject: SubscriberAccount
semantic_observation: Successful proofing typically establishes unique subscriber account
formalization_or_cq_signal: Enrollment creates managed relationship/representation, distinct from Provisioning

subject: Proofing
semantic_observation: IAL is dimension-specific proofing assurance, not universal LoA
formalization_or_cq_signal: Model dimension+level rather than one overloaded assurance scalar

subject: Authenticator
semantic_observation: Authenticator is associated with subscriber account at enrollment or later

subject: Authenticator
semantic_observation: Authenticator association/usability changes independently from account identity
formalization_or_cq_signal: Cross-vendor lifecycle comparison required before adding status/event classes

subject: Authentication
formalization_or_cq_signal: Assurance dimension must reference authentication not subject identity generally

subject: Session
semantic_observation: Session follows successful authentication and has independent lifecycle
formalization_or_cq_signal: Add/test explicit Authentication establishes Session relation

subject: SyncableAuthenticator
semantic_observation: One authentication capability/key can be synchronized across devices under constraints
formalization_or_cq_signal: Authenticator instance vs key/material/device relation needs careful profile modeling

subject: Subscriber-IdP-RP
semantic_observation: Three-party relationship across separate administration; assertion carries auth/attributes
formalization_or_cq_signal: Supports Federation relator/roles without merging account/admin domains

subject: Assertion
semantic_observation: Assertion is per-login artifact with audience and lifetime constraints
formalization_or_cq_signal: Need federation assertion profile artifact and temporal SHACL constraints

subject: RP Session
semantic_observation: RP session begins after federation processing and remains independent from IdP session
formalization_or_cq_signal: Strong CQ for session non-equivalence across federation parties

subject: InformationRelease
semantic_observation: Existence of federation does not authorize attribute release
formalization_or_cq_signal: Trust/federation relation must not imply Permission

subject: HolderOfKeyAssertion
semantic_observation: Subscriber proves possession of assertion-bound key independently of IdP auth key
formalization_or_cq_signal: Proof relation is contextual and key-bound; avoid equating assertion with authenticator
